summary: Each rank repeats its local CSR SpMV for the requested iteration count. Native code inlines the timed iteration, row, and nonzero loops with indexed loads, accumulation, and row stores; source shows rank-local row/item slices and offset rebasing.

source_evidence.claim: -i is parsed; rank-local CSR offsets are rebased after scatter; the timed loop invokes spmvCpu once per iteration, and each row routine traverses its nonzero interval, accumulates products, and stores output.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed main records start time, then runs an iteration counter around inlined row/nonzero loops with column/vector/value loads, multiply/add, output stores, and row/iteration backedges before the end-time call.
